Blender art spike: review

Ten assets from the current design, made by Claude with Blender scripts and rendered as toon sprites (the game is 2D Phaser). The agent's score sits next to each sheet. Record your own verdict below it. Choices save in this browser; Copy verdicts puts them on the clipboard as markdown to paste back to Claude.

  • Is this the Atelier look you want (pastel, chunky bevels, outlines, cute)? If not, the fix is in style_lib, not per asset.
  • Bottom row of each sheet = the game view at true phone size (DPR 3): board at 48.6°, units and enemies as Arknights-style side sprites (15°, facing right; enemies mirrored). Judge there first.
  • Does each asset read at that size: what it is, its role, its tier?
  • Do the assets look like one game when side by side (overview)?

Your verdict

Hero test: sprite camera angle

Left pair: medic at the game camera (48.6°) and at 15°. Right pair: the same for the Stone golem. At 48.6° you see the top of the head and lose the face; at 15° both read better. Units are upright billboard sprites, so the sprite angle can differ from the board tilt (as in Arknights). Decided 2026-10-28: Arknights-style side views at 15° (now the default).

Hero test: front projection vs Hunyuan Paint

Top row: colour projected from the front reference. Bottom row: Hunyuan Paint texture. Columns: front at 15°, front at the game camera, back, side. Paint fixes the back, side and crown; eyes are slightly softer.

Why not generate the action pose: references (idle, then 3 action tries)

Independent generations drift in proportions, hair and outfit, which is why the action still poses the idle model.

Hero action still: the idle model, rigged and posed

Sprites at true size: idle front, idle back, action front, action back. Same mesh and texture, so one identity. The generated staff is replaced by a built one on her near hand; the cast is exaggerated (she grips low and thrusts the staff high) because chibi arms are too short to lift it. The bottom row of her contact sheet shows the swap in the game view: same foot anchor.

Overall

Go / no-go on this pipeline, and anything about the style itself
